caption: The drawing depicts a single, vertically oriented blue wooden post with a pointed, conical top. The surface of the post is visibly weathered, showing textures, cracks, and areas of exposed wood grain in brown and gray tones. Attached to the post near its upper left side, there is a short horizontal cylinder, also wooden and blue, appearing as if it is fastened to the post with a metallic pin or nail. Emerging from the upper part and curving downward to the right, a long, thin, brown metal rod or wire is attached, ending in a hexagonal or nut-like object. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background framed by a thin, double-lined border.
title: Pump
